data.title: Qualcomm pares Rs 184 crore stake in Shadowfax; promoter acquires 2.7% in Shanthi Gears
data.description:
American multinational company Qualcomm Incorporated has pared its stake worth Rs 184 crore in Shadowfax Technologies, the technology-driven logistics firm, through open-market transactions on August 21.

According to bulk deals data available on the stock exchanges, Qualcomm Asia Pacific Pte, a subsidiary of US-based Qualcomm Incorporated, sold 75 lakh shares, representing a 1.28 percent stake in Shadowfax Technologies, compared with its 2.26 percent holding as of June 2026. The shares were sold at Rs 245.13 apiece, valuing the transaction at Rs 183.8 crore.

In fact, in the current quarter, a few other marquee investors have also pared their stakes in Shadowfax. Newquest Asia Fund IV (Singapore) sold a 2.13 percent stake on August 6, while Flipkart Internet offloaded a 5.48 percent stake and Eight Roads Investments Mauritius II sold a 7.67 percent stake on July 24.

Shadowfax shares ended at Rs 255.40 on the National Stock Exchange on Friday, down 1.01 percent amid high trading volumes. Overall, however, the stock has been on an upward trajectory since mid-March, despite intermittent corrections. The stock has already doubled from its offer price of Rs 124 per share since its listing on January 28, 2026.

Separate Bulk Deals

Promoter Tube Investments of India has picked up 20.64 lakh shares, representing a 2.69 percent stake in Shanthi Gears, from Pacific Assets Trust Plc for Rs 77.49 crore. The shares were acquired at Rs 375.30 apiece.

Following the block deal, Shanthi Gears shares appeared to have hit the 20 percent upper circuit, ending at Rs 464.25 after opening with a gap-up.

Pacific Assets Trust held 22.21 lakh shares, or a 2.9 percent stake, in Shanthi Gears as of June 2026.

Meanwhile, ChrysCapital-owned Clarus Capital 1 has picked up 1.32 lakh shares, representing a 1.07 percent stake in KDDL, the manufacturer of watch components, high-quality precision-stamped components and progressive tools for engineering applications. The shares were acquired for Rs 48.21 crore at Rs 3,650 apiece.

However, promoter Pranav Shankar Saboo sold 2.46 lakh shares, representing a 2 percent stake, for Rs 89.8 crore at Rs 3,650.81 per share. KDDL shares ended at Rs 4,005.40 on the National Stock Exchange on Friday, following a significant recovery in the last couple of hours of trading.

Major activity was also seen in Nxt-Infra Trust, an infrastructure investment trust that invests in road infrastructure assets. Kotak Mahindra Bank, Larsen & Toubro, and Kotak Mahindra Investments picked up 2.63 crore units in Nxt-Infra InvIT from Actis Highway Infra for Rs 247.29 crore at Rs 93.85 per unit.

Additionally, Actis Highway Infra sold 64.5 lakh units in Nxt-Infra Trust for Rs 60.9 crore at Rs 94.40 per unit. LGT Wealth India, meanwhile, bought 35.75 lakh units at Rs 94.10 per unit, valuing the transaction at Rs 33.64 crore.

data.title: Metaguest Completes Corporate Continuance to Ontario
data.description:
Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - August 21, 2026) - Metaguest.AI Incorporated ("Metaguest" or the "Company"), an AI technology company transforming the hospitality sector through intelligent guest engagement is pleased to announce that it has completed its move from Alberta to Ontario as its corporate jurisdiction (the "Continuance").

The Continuance better aligns the Company's corporate jurisdiction with its Ontario-based operations and supports its strategy of pursuing government funding and support programs available in the province. The Company has been working with Arctech Accelerate to assess funding opportunities that may support the continued development and commercialization of Metaguest's technology platform and intends to continue pursuing applicable federal and Ontario programs.

The Continuance was approved by shareholders at the Company's Annual and Special Meeting of Shareholders held on October 1, 2025. As a result, the Company is now governed by the Business Corporations Act (Ontario). The Continuance does not change the Company's business, management, share capital or listing on the Canadian Securities Exchange, and no action is required by shareholders.

About Metaguest.AI Incorporated

Metaguest.AI is a next-generation technology company focused on enhancing the guest experience through advanced AI solutions. Its flagship platform provides an end-to-end guest engagement ecosystem, covering everything from pre-arrival to post-departure. Features include on-property e-commerce with digital payments, real-time service requests, mobile check-out, personalized in-room controls, local experience and event bookings, and a multilingual virtual concierge—all accessible without downloading an app or visiting a website. Hotels, resorts, and short-term rental operators use Metaguest to boost efficiency, drive incremental revenue, and elevate customer satisfaction.

data.title: Brazil regulator lifts measure barring Hapvida price hikes, policy cancellations
data.description:
Brazil's health regulator, ANS, said on Friday it had suspended a precautionary measure imposed a day earlier that barred health plan operator Hapvida from raising prices or terminating about 950,000 private health insurance plans.

  • ANS said the decision followed a meeting with Hapvida on Friday morning and was based on clarifications provided by the company.

  • Hapvida did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

  • The regulator had imposed the measure on Thursday after Hapvida said it would seek to renegotiate contracts that were either in default or no longer profitable, a move that could have resulted in cancellations.

data.title: ICE Review: Sharp Declines for Canola on Profit-Taking, Losses in Chicago
data.description:
WINNIPEG, Manitoba--Intercontinental Exchange canola futures were weaker, largely due to profit-taking.

An analyst said Friday the speculative funds currently hold a very large long position in canola, and they don't want to be caught with it when the harvest is fully under way. If they do, the analyst said that would result in steep declines.

Pressure on canola also came from sharp losses in Chicago soyoil and more modest declines in European rapeseed. That was tempered by gains in crude oil, Chicago soybeans and soymeal, as well as Malaysian palm oil.

With the losses, the November canola contract took a big step down toward its 20-day moving average.

The Canadian Grain Commission reported canola exports for the week ended Aug. 16 of 116,200 metric tons, down nearly 50% from the previous week. Domestic use came to 267,200 tons, up almost 6% from last week.

Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada upped its call on the 2026-27 canola harvest by 600,000 tons, now at 21.6 million. In contrast, the U.S. Agriculture Department projected the harvest at 22.5 million tons.

The Canadian dollar nudged higher at 72.66 U.S. cents, compared to Thursday's close of 72.54.

There were 48,315 canola contracts traded on Friday, compared to 57,710 on Thursday. Spreading accounted for 18,522 contracts traded.

data.title: CDC, FDA Investigates E. Coli, Salmonella Infections Linked to Alfalfa Sprouts
data.description:
By Josh Beckerman

Health officials are investigating E. coli and salmonella infections in several states linked to alfalfa sprouts, with the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention reporting 55 cases, including two people infected with both E. coli and salmonella.

The CDC and the FDA said alfalfa sprouts grown by Minneapolis-based Everything Sprouts and sold under the brands Calco and Everything Sprouts are linked to the outbreak.

The FDA said traceback evidence collected from restaurants and grocery stores identified the company's sprouts as a source of illness.

Everything Sprouts said it voluntarily recalled certain lots of sprouts and is continuing to work with the FDA, CDC and state authorities. During the outbreak, the company has tested its products daily and hasn't received any positive lab results.

The items being recalled were distributed to certain third-party distributors and grocery stores in Minnesota and Wisconsin. The CDC said cases have been reported in 15 states, with the majority in Minnesota and Wisconsin.

Everything Sprouts produces hydroponic sprouts, with products such as mung beans, broccoli and radish sprouts.
